name: Makim
title: Give the team one set of commands
description: Makim puts build, test, and data tasks in one YAML file, so new teammates and CI can run the same documented commands.

name: Sugar
title: Save a container setup for each environment
description: Sugar stores the Docker Compose services and configuration for development or testing in named profiles. Teammates can run the same setup without piecing together command-line options.

name: HiperHealth
title: Keep AI workflow steps reviewable
description: HiperHealth separates document extraction, data collection, and AI processing so clinical researchers can review each step. It saves sessions in Parquet for later analysis.
status: Early development · Production targeted for early 2027

name: FreeCampus
title: Reuse exercises across courses and notebooks
description: FreeCampus Tools lets educators write a quiz once and reuse it on a course page, in Jupyter, or in Colab.
status: Learning app in early development · Production targeted for early 2027

name: Arx ecosystem
title: Build a language around scientific data
description: Arx explores how a custom language can work with scientific data. Its frontend parses the code, ASTx represents its structure, and IRx compiles it through LLVM. Apache Arrow provides the data containers.
